episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the ongoing conflict between Compass, Zillow, and MLS over listing data and its implications for agents. He shares innovative AI-driven solutions for common real estate challenges, including a novel insurance product to reduce transaction cancellations. The conversation also covers how agents can leverage AI to stay informed and enhance their personal brand.
